tabs.html:
Dinstar C60SP Entry IP Phone – Affordable and Reliable Communication Solution

The Dinstar C60SP Entry-Level Business IP Phone offers a cost-effective and high-quality communication solution for businesses of all sizes. Designed to provide seamless VoIP (Voice over IP) functionality, this advanced phone delivers crystal-clear audio, user-friendly features, and a professional design, making it the perfect choice for any modern business environment.


Key Features:

  • High-Definition Audio Quality: Enjoy clear, distortion-free voice communication for enhanced productivity and customer service.
  • Multiple SIP Accounts: Supports multiple SIP accounts, allowing businesses to manage different lines efficiently.
  • Large LCD Display: Features an easy-to-read backlit LCD screen for better visibility and improved navigation.
  • Customizable Keys: Equipped with programmable keys for quick access to frequently used functions, boosting efficiency.
  • Easy Installation & Configuration: Simplifies deployment with automatic provisioning and support for various SIP-based platforms.
  • Cost-Effective Solution: Ideal for businesses seeking a reliable, budget-friendly phone system without compromising on performance.
  • PoE Support: Power over Ethernet (PoE) compatibility ensures a clean setup with minimal wiring.
